name: hurricanemap
description: Static NOAA HURDAT2 hurricane landfall map.

scripts.build: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:sw && npm run validate:data && npm run test:url-state && npm run test:filter-state && npm run test:impact-utils && npm run test:similarity-vectors && npm run test:cone-utils && npm run test:storm-events && npm run test:globe3d-utils && npm run test:exposure-utils && npm run test:hurdat2-refresh && npm run test:goes-realtime && npm run test:active-polling && npm run test:bundle-audit && npm run test:cdn-worker && npm run test:dockerfile
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:offline-smoke
